description:
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus artifact token.
Resolve Man-o'-War. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Man-o'-War trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat
